import json, subprocess, sys

          'long2.jsonl', 'big4.jsonl']

    data = open(t, 'rb').read()

                        '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    src = data.decode().splitlines()
    ok = len(lines) == len(src) and p.returncode == 0
    statuses = []
    for ln in lines:
        try:
            statuses.append(json.loads(ln)['status'])
        except Exception:
            statuses.append('BADJSON')
    print('%-16s lines %d/%d %s statuses=%s' % (
        t, len(lines), len(src), 'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH',
        sorted(set(statuses))))
    if p.stderr:
        print('   stderr:', p.stderr.decode()[:200])
